title: Full-race replay from the Results screen (#646, part of #542)
summary: After a race, Results then Replay now plays the whole race from the grid before GO to 3 s after the finish: player, CPUs, split-screen riders and ghost, with the existing Chase, Trackside and Orbit cameras, play/pause, 2 s skip, slow motion and photo mode. The hint reads RACE REPLAY m:ss / m:ss.
details: The #572 recorder was extended to 15 Hz with a fixed 24 MiB budget that halves the sample rate when full, and node matrices are quantised to 16 bits. On sx01 (1 lap, 3 CPUs, 1:16) the buffer is 9.6 MiB versus 78.6 MiB for the old layout. Also fixed: a mouse or touch press on the Results Replay button did nothing. Evidence: no full-race replay exists in the original executable (only the STOPCAM cheat's strings), so this is an approved enhancement, not original behavior. Verification: 11 recorder unit tests, new test_engine_race_replay.mjs, test_engine_replay.mjs and make precheck; host only.
limitation: No replay sound or particles; online races are not recorded; long races play back at a coarser rate after thinning; not measured on a phone.
